Samira — thanks for the quick note and for sending the headers. I can see from the .ics that the organizer is our internal host account (olga@redwood.com) and the forwarded attendee is arriving via a different domain; sometimes Google/Exchange strips the join button for proxied forwards.

Plan proposal:
- Short term: send a one-click Zoom backup link for this slot and update the event description with both links (we'll keep the Meet link as-is).
- Medium term: reissue a new invite with 'organizer' set to an AcmeTech address (if your IT allows) or make the Redwood invite 'guest-friendly' by adding the shared mailbox as an invitee rather than forwarding.

Ben, Grace — can one of you create a temporary Zoom meeting and a new calendar event that mirrors the current slot? Prefer to avoid changing the time. Samira — if you prefer we can also create a separate invite from an AcmeTech organizer address (let me know).

I'll attach the demo deck and the headers I saved so you have context.

Thanks,

On it — creating Zoom temp host now. A couple technical notes:
- Forwarded-ICS problem looks like the GCal invite had ORGANIZER:<olga@redwood.com> and the attendee is being added via a forwarded-email address; GCal hides Meet for attendees who aren't explicit invitees.
- Workaround: create a new event and explicitly invite the shared mailbox and the individual addresses (this restores the 'Join with Google Meet' UI). Alternatively, we can add a Zoom link and set the event conferencing to 'Zoom (external)'; attendees won't need Meet auth.

I'll make the new event and paste the Zoom join below. Grace, please update the Redwood demo doc to include the alternate link.

Passcode: demo2026
